input.answer: To get a kind of saving explained, you tap the "להבין סוג של חיסכון" card on the home page. That takes you to the "מדריך" list, and I'd scroll right down to the "מדד S&P 500" card, since S&P is the thing I've heard about. Then again, the page says S&P is only "במה הכסף מושקע" and not a product of its own, so I still don't know what I'd actually be opening.

stuck.why: The big box on the right, "מה השאלה שלכם?", has chips and ₪ fields, but it's for finding what fits me, not for explaining anything. The card that answers my question, "להבין סוג של חיסכון", is in the left column, where I nearly missed it.
It opens with "שני חלקים בכל חיסכון" and then "מאיפה להתחיל", which points me to קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה and קרן כספית. None of that is S&P, so I didn't know if I was in the right place.
There's a long grid of cards (עו"ש, פיקדון, מק"ם, פרישה, ילדים...) and I had to scroll past all of it before S&P showed up, two screens down.
I found "מדד S&P 500", but it sits under "what the money is invested in". So is it a thing I buy, or do I still need one of the cards from the top? I got confused there.

"מדד S&P 500" card title and its first line "מדד של חמש מאות החברות הגדולות בארצות הברית"
skimmed: the card grids under כסף שוטף וקצר, חיסכון עם הטבת מס, פרישה, ילדים, לבחירה עצמית
the other index cards (MSCI, נאסד"ק, ת"א)
skipped: the "מה השאלה שלכם?" form and its ₪ fields
footer and the small grey lines
not_found: any line telling me how I'd actually put money into S&P (which bank, which product)

findings.what: The S&P 500 card, the one thing everyone has heard of, is buried at the bottom of the second section after more than 15 cards, and nothing at the top points to it
It isn't clear whether S&P is something I buy or only something inside a product, so I don't know which card to tap
findings.where: מדריך, the split between "איפה הכסף מוחזק" and "במה הכסף מושקע"

findings.what: Almost every index card repeats the same "הכסף מושקע בשקלים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו, עם חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו". I kept rereading it to find what was different, and once would have been enough
The "explain me a saving" card sits in the left column, while the eye goes first to the big form on the right
Too many cards that look alike. If I had come in without a name in mind, I'd have closed the page
The descriptions are full of words I don't know (מק"ם, צמודה, פיקדונות בנקאיים, תשואת המק"מ)
